zones.name: Patio soleado
zones.prompt: Cheerful sunny backyard on a birthday morning. Bright square-wave lead, bouncy bass, light drums, catchy major-key melody, about 104 bpm.

zones.name: Mate y pala
zones.prompt: Playful, upbeat digging-with-a-shovel theme. Plucky chiptune lead, snappy drums, cheerful and fast, about 120 bpm.

zones.name: Cumbia del cantero
zones.prompt: Argentine cumbia meets chiptune: güiro, cumbia drum groove, accordion-like synth lead, festive birthday party vibe, about 100 bpm.

zones.name: Cuevas de cristal
zones.prompt: Mysterious but cozy underground crystal cave exploration. Glassy chimes, soft arpeggios, echoing triangle-wave melody, about 88 bpm.

zones.name: Eco del granito
zones.prompt: Adventurous mining theme deeper underground. Steady drums, echoing synth melody, a little tension and a lot of wonder, about 100 bpm.

zones.name: Minero de medianoche
zones.prompt: Laid-back midnight miner groove. Plucked synth lead, warm round bass, relaxed lo-fi retro game feel, about 92 bpm.

zones.name: Abismo
zones.prompt: Dark, vast abyss deep underground. Bell tones, deep sub bass, slow and eerie but still melodic, about 76 bpm.

zones.name: Corazón de la tierra
zones.prompt: Glowing lava caverns near the center of the Earth. Rising tension, triangle-wave arpeggios, mysterious melody, about 96 bpm.

zones.name: Latido de magma
zones.prompt: Magma chamber with a heartbeat drum pulse, ominous choir pads and a slow building tension, about 84 bpm.

zones.name: Combate final
zones.prompt: Epic final boss battle against a wizard eagle. Galloping drums, heroic synth-brass lead, very intense and fast, about 152 bpm.

zones.name: Lluvia de magma
zones.prompt: Frantic boss fight while fire rains from above. Driving drums, gritty saw-wave leads, heroic and urgent, about 160 bpm.

zones.name: Furia de Aguilus
zones.prompt: Dramatic, slightly comedic villain boss theme. Organ and choir over chiptune drums, epic and theatrical, about 144 bpm.
